item.title: Thailand’s 2025 auto sales climb to 2-year high on EV demand
item.description: BANGKOK: Thailand’s automobile sales rose to a two-year high in 2025 as exponential growth in electric vehicle purchases drove demand despite the backdrop of lackluster economic growth.
